components.selectPrompt: Click any 3D equipment to inspect its governing laws, live equations, and inlet/outlet state points.

compressor.name: Axial Air Compressor
compressor.role: Compresses ambient air from p1 to p2 before combustion.

combustor.name: Combustion Chamber
combustor.role: Adds chemical heat from fuel at nearly constant pressure to reach T3.

gasTurbine.name: Gas Turbine
gasTurbine.role: Expands hot combustion gas from p3 to p4 to drive the compressor and generator.

hrsg.name: Heat Recovery Steam Generator (HRSG)
hrsg.role: Transfers exhaust heat from gas (4→5) to water/steam (7→8) subject to the pinch point constraint.

steamTurbine.name: Steam Turbine
steamTurbine.role: Expands superheated steam from p8 to condenser pressure p9 to produce Rankine shaft work.

condenser.name: Surface Condenser
condenser.role: Condenses wet exhaust steam from state 9 to saturated liquid at state 6.

pump.name: Feedwater Pump
pump.role: Pressurizes saturated liquid water from condenser pressure p6 to boiler pressure p7.

generator.name: Synchronous Electric Generator
generator.role: Couples net gas turbine and steam turbine shaft power into electrical output.
generator.shaftGridNote: Shaft speed is fixed by the grid frequency

labels.4: 4 — Gas Turbine Exhaust / HRSG Gas Inlet
labels.7: 7 — Feedwater Pump Outlet / HRSG Water Inlet

law1.title: 1. First Law of Thermodynamics (Steady Flow)
law1.explanation: Energy conservation for an open control volume in steady flow with negligible kinetic and potential energy changes.

law2.title: 2. Second Law & Isentropic Efficiency
law2.formula: η_t = (h_in − h_out) / (h_in − h_out,s) ; η_c = (h_out,s − h_in) / (h_out − h_in)
law2.explanation: Quantifies irreversibilities (entropy generation) in adiabatic turbines, compressors, and pumps relative to an ideal isentropic process.

law3.title: 3. Ideal Gas Equation of State
law3.formula: p · v = R · T ; cp − cv = R ; k = cp / cv
law3.explanation: Relates pressure, specific volume, and absolute temperature for air and combustion gases with constant specific heats.

law4.title: 4. Isentropic Relations for Ideal Gases
law4.explanation: Connects temperature ratio and pressure ratio along a reversible adiabatic (constant entropy) path for an ideal gas.

law5.title: 5. Ideal Brayton Cycle Efficiency
law5.explanation: Theoretical thermal efficiency of a cold-air-standard Brayton cycle as a function of compressor pressure ratio r_p.

law6.title: 6. Rankine Cycle Thermal Efficiency
law6.explanation: Ratio of net specific steam cycle work (turbine minus pump) to specific heat absorbed in the steam generator.

law7.title: 7. HRSG Energy Balance & Pinch Point
law7.formula: ṁ_g · cp_g · ΔT_g = ṁ_s · Δh_s ; ΔT_pinch = T_g,evap − T_sat
law7.explanation: Couples the gas and steam cycles via first-law heat recovery while enforcing the minimum temperature approach (pinch point) at the evaporator inlet.

law8.title: 8. Combustion Heat Input
law8.explanation: Relates thermal power released into the working gas to fuel mass flow rate, lower heating value (LHV), and combustor efficiency.

law9.title: 9. Combined Cycle Thermal Efficiency
law9.explanation: Overall plant efficiency combining the topping Brayton cycle (η_GT), HRSG heat recovery fraction (η_HRSG), and bottoming Rankine cycle (η_ST).

law10.title: 10. Conservation of Mass (Continuity)
law10.explanation: At steady state, the total mass flow rate entering any control volume equals the total mass flow rate leaving it.
law10.airStandardNote: Air-standard assumption: fuel mass neglected in the gas path

errors.title: Thermodynamic Operating Limit Reached
errors.PINCH_POINT_VIOLATION: HRSG Pinch Point Violation: Gas turbine exhaust temperature (T4) is too low to maintain the required 15 K pinch temperature difference and superheat steam to 450 °C. Increase Turbine Inlet Temperature (T3) or reduce Pressure Ratio (rp).
errors.GAS_EXHAUST_BELOW_STEAM_TEMP: Temperature Crossing in HRSG Superheater: Gas turbine exhaust temperature (T4) is below the required live steam temperature (T8 = 723.15 K + 15 K approach). Increase T3 or lower rp.
errors.NEGATIVE_COMBUSTION_HEAT: Invalid Combustor State: Compressor outlet temperature (T2) exceeds or equals Turbine Inlet Temperature (T3). Increase T3 or reduce rp.
errors.NEGATIVE_GT_WORK: Negative Net Gas Turbine Output: Compressor work exceeds turbine expansion work at these conditions.
errors.STACK_TEMP_BELOW_FEEDWATER: HRSG Acid/Feedwater Temperature Crossing: Stack gas temperature (T5) dropped below incoming feedwater temperature (T7).
